panels.title: Top 10 Series by Views (last 10 min)
panels.description: watch events in a rolling last-10-minutes window, computed by the trending-rankings job over reporting-db.watch_events.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.rank, r.item_id, i.title, r.view_count FROM item_view_ranking r JOIN items i ON i.item_id = r.item_id WHERE r.type = 'series' ORDER BY r.rank

panels.title: Top 10 Movies by Views (last 10 min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.rank, r.item_id, i.title, r.view_count FROM item_view_ranking r JOIN items i ON i.item_id = r.item_id WHERE r.type = 'movie' ORDER BY r.rank

panels.title: Top 10 Series by Rating (last 10 min)
panels.description: rating events (latest per user+item, given within the window) in a rolling last-10-minutes window, computed by the trending-rankings job over reporting-db.ratings.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.rank, r.item_id, i.title, r.avg_rating, r.rating_count FROM item_rating_ranking r JOIN items i ON i.item_id = r.item_id WHERE r.type = 'series' ORDER BY r.rank
